root_cause: On a clean install Tauri spawned naia-agent before onboarding selected an ADK root. The native process captured a missing ~/.naia/adk-path once; the UI later wrote the path without awaiting it or restarting/rebinding the running agent, and credential initialization had already run with no providers. The bundled Node runtime was present and preferred, so Node installation was not the cause.
implemented: Await ADK-path persistence and restart/rebind the native agent only when the selected root changes
Delay credential initialization until setup and onboarding finish
Return an explicit UTF-8 Korean OAuth completion page without mojibake
Wait for Herdr snapshot readiness and retry bounded startup failures
Preserve the user's two-way chat placement when Workspace opens and remove the retired center-chat mode
Use a face-centered avatar grid with NVA/VRM badges and default to the Naia NVA
Remove hard-coded D: paths from native E2E setup and support isolated portable roots
